title: ServicePort
description: A port mapping within a Service, defining the protocol, service-facing port, and the target pod port.

name.description: Port name. Must be unique within the ports list and conform to DNS_LABEL format. Required for multi-port Services.

port.description: Port number the Service listens on.

targetPort.description: Port number or named port on the Pod to forward traffic to. Defaults to the value of port.

protocol.description: Network protocol for this port. Defaults to TCP.

nodePort.description: Port exposed on each node for NodePort and LoadBalancer service types. Allocated automatically if not specified.

appProtocol.description: Application-layer protocol hint for the port. Examples: h2c, ws, wss, kubernetes.io/h2c.
